items: Repeat guests drive a large share of restaurant revenue, so keeping the guests you already have is usually a bigger growth opportunity than chasing new ones.
Better guest satisfaction leads to higher return rates and more repeat visits, especially when you focus on improving your underperforming locations.
Bring reviews, surveys and direct messages into one platform so you can respond faster, recover unhappy guests and see what drives satisfaction at each location.
Use guest data for personalized offers such as birthday rewards or order-based recommendations, which help turn occasional diners into regulars.
Track CSAT, repeat-visit rate and response time across channels to see what's working and prove the return on your guest experience efforts.
